description.title: Display and performance
text: iPad Pro 11-inch (2021) has an 11-inch Liquid Retina display with IPS technology and a resolution of 2388 by 1668 pixels. It supports ProMotion, True Tone and the P3 wide color gamut.
The Apple M1 chip combines an eight-core CPU, an eight-core GPU and a sixteen-core Neural Engine.

description.title: Cameras and Face ID
text: The rear camera system combines a 12MP Wide camera with a 10MP Ultra Wide camera. A LiDAR scanner supports augmented reality experiences.
The front-facing 12MP Ultra Wide TrueDepth camera supports Center Stage during video calls. The TrueDepth system also enables Face ID facial recognition.

description.title: Video and connectivity
text: The Wide rear camera records 4K video at up to 60 frames per second. Full HD slow-motion recording is available at 120 or 240 frames per second.
The Thunderbolt / USB 4 port supports charging and compatible accessories. The tablet also supports Apple Pencil (2nd generation).

text: The rear 8MP camera features an f/2.4 aperture, autofocus and HDR photography. It supports Full HD video recording and stabilized time-lapse video.

text: A Touch ID fingerprint sensor is built into the Home button, allowing you to unlock the tablet and authenticate purchases.
